**Description**
 Are you interested in building high\-performance, globally scalable systems that support Amazon's current and future growth? Are you seeking an environment where you can drive innovation? Does the prospect of working with top engineering talent get you charged up? If so, UTR Tech in Last Mile is for you.
   

  

 UTR Tech is looking for a highly motivated Software Development Engineer to help build Amazon's business critical logistics systems and build system solutions to operate at scale. You will work on critical business functions for our customers around the world while meeting system availability goals and ensuring system performance with growing business needs. You will discover innovative ways to automate and scale our infrastructure as we expand globally. You will work together with multiple teams and departments, with plenty of opportunities to learn and grow.
   

  

 The ideal candidate has a passion for understanding computing systems and for applying that understanding with an obsession for delighting customers. In this role, you will apply your skills of system design, networking, coding/scripting languages, as well as technical communication and project organization to make your impact on improving our business processes. The candidate is expected to contribute work critical initiatives, build products, lead engineers to troubleshoot, debug, evaluate and resolve computer\-identified alarms, make feature enhancements, systems management, perform software deployments and migrations, host management and automate the operational tasks.
   

  

 They would also be responsible to develop tools and end to end automation to achieve human free operations.
   

  

 As an Engineer in the team, you will take part in in the architecture, design, implementation and deployment of large\-scale and complex software systems. You will get to leverage your experience and expertise to deliver innovative solutions to challenging problems. You will communicate your ideas effectively to achieve the right outcome for your team and customer. You enjoy collaborating with others to increase the effectiveness of the overall team. Your code, design, and implementation decisions should set a great example to other engineers. You will also have the opportunity to impact the technical decisions in the broader organization as well as mentor other engineers in the team.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Experience with distributed systems at scale
* High level design competencies
* Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting large\-scale infrastructure
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, Python


**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

**About The Role**
 What if the code you write could directly power the AI systems shaping how millions of people interact with technology? We're looking for Back End Developers in Delhi to design, build, and optimize the server\-side systems and APIs that drive cutting\-edge AI products — from data pipelines and model\-serving infrastructure to scalable microservices that handle real\-world traffic at scale.
   

  

 This is a fully remote, flexible contract role open to experienced engineers and strong developers ready to apply their skills to AI\-adjacent infrastructure.
   

  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week


**What You'll Do**
* Design, develop, and maintain robust back end services, APIs, and data pipelines
* Build scalable, high\-performance server\-side architecture to support AI training and inference workloads
* Write clean, well\-documented, and testable code following engineering best practices
* Integrate with databases, message queues, cloud services, and third\-party APIs
* Optimize system performance, reliability, and scalability as usage grows
* Collaborate asynchronously with distributed teams of engineers, researchers, and product leads
* Troubleshoot production issues, conduct code reviews, and contribute to architectural decisions

**Who You Are**
* Proficient in one or more back end languages — Python, Go, Java, Node.js, Rust, or similar
* Solid understanding of RESTful API design, microservices architecture, and distributed systems
* Experienced with relational and/or NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, etc.)
* Comfortable working with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure
* Familiar with version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to debug complex systems independently
* Self\-motivated, reliable, and effective when working asynchronously
* Clear communicator who can document decisions and collaborate across time zones


**Nice to Have**
* Experience building infrastructure for machine learning or AI systems
* Familiarity with data processing frameworks (Apache Kafka, Spark, Airflow, or similar)
* Background in performance optimization, caching strategies, or high\-throughput systems
* Knowledge of authentication, authorization, and security best practices
* Experience with serverless architectures or event\-driven design patterns
* Contributions to open\-source projects or a strong portfolio of personal/professional work


**Why Join Us**
* Work on cutting\-edge AI infrastructure projects alongside leading research labs
* Fully remote and flexible — set your own hours and work from anywhere
* Freelance autonomy with access to meaningful, technically challenging work
* Build systems at the intersection of software engineering and artificial intelligence
* Collaborate with a global network of talented engineers and researchers
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

 Python \& AI Stack

 Cloud \& Enterprise Deployment

* Strong understanding of managed identities, secure credential management, and enterprise deployment patterns.
* Experience integrating with Microsoft Graph API, Power Automate, Salesforce, or similar enterprise systems.



 Agentic Architecture
 


* Demonstrated ability to design multi\-agent systems with tool usage, memory, planning, guardrails, observability, and HITL approval gates.

 As AI continues to play an increasingly important role in our products, you'll also help build intelligent workflows, integrate AI services, and explore new ways of using modern language models to improve customer experiences and internal operations.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Designing and building backend services in Laravel, from architecture through to production
* Working on core platform capabilities: data modelling, APIs, background processing, and integrations
* Designing secure, well\-documented, versioned REST APIs
* Building event\-driven and asynchronous systems with queues and background jobs
* Optimising database performance and application scalability
* Writing automated tests and helping improve our engineering and release practices
* Integrating third\-party services, including commerce, logistics, and AI/LLM APIs
* Reviewing code and helping raise the overall standard of the team


**Requirements**
**What we're looking for**
* 7\+ years of professional backend development, with at least 3 years of strong Laravel experience in production systems you helped design — we care more about what you've built than the exact number of years
* Deep understanding of Object\-Oriented Programming (OOP), SOLID principles, design patterns, and system design
* Strong data modelling and system design instincts, and the ability to reason about trade\-offs
* Experience with Shopify APIs, Eloquent ORM optimisation, MySQL performance tuning, Redis, queue\-based systems, AWS infrastructure, and scalable REST APIs is essential
* Solid MySQL depth (indexing, query optimisation, performance under growth), plus Redis and queue\-based asynchronous processing
* Experience with AWS, Docker, Linux, Git, CI/CD, application monitoring, and performance optimization is essential
* Testing as a habit, you write tests, you expect CI to catch problems, and you take reliability seriously
* Working knowledge of AWS (EC2, RDS, S3, IAM, CloudWatch), enough to be self\-sufficient
* Clear written communication and the ability to document and defend design decisions


**Nice to have**
* Experience in a regulated domain (healthcare, fintech, or similar) where compliance and auditability are design inputs
* Multi\-tenant SaaS experience
* LLM integration work (Anthropic or OpenAI APIs), with an interest in evaluation and reliability rather than demos
* Shopify API experience
* Event\-driven architecture in production


**Tech stack**
 PHP 8\.x / Laravel (Horizon, Queues, Events, Scheduler)
   

  

* MySQL
* Redis
* REST APIs
* AWS
* Docker
* GitHub Actions
* Anthropic \& OpenAI APIs
* Vue.js \+ Inertia on the frontend (this is a backend\-focused role; frontend fluency is welcome but not required) The challenges you'll be working on


 As part of our engineering team, you'll work on a variety of technical challenges, including:
   

  

* Designing backend systems capable of handling millions of requests
* Building AI\-powered products and integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) into real\-world workflows
* Architecting and developing greenfield applications from concept to production
* Scaling and optimising large Laravel codebases
* Designing secure, maintainable, and high\-performance REST APIs
* Building event\-driven and asynchronous systems using queues and background processing
* Optimising database performance, caching strategies, and application scalability
* Improving developer experience through automation, tooling, and engineering best practices
* Building reliable cloud\-native applications on AWS


**Benefits**
*We're an equal\-opportunity employer. As a regulated healthcare business, the successful candidate will undergo a basic background check.*

title: Lead Backend Engineer - Data Platform
description:
**ABOUT WINGIFY:** 




 Wingify \+ AB Tasty is a global leader in Digital Experience Optimization. In 2026, VWO and AB Tasty joined forces to build a unified platform spanning experimentation, personalization, feature management, behavioural insights, and AI.
 



 Together, we serve 4,000\+ customers globally, with nearly 800 people across 11 offices and more than $100M in revenue.
 



 Both companies were founded 15\+ years ago with experimentation at their core and share a similar engineering philosophy: deep thinking, fast execution, strong ownership, and minimal bureaucracy.
 



 As we bring two mature technology platforms together, we are solving complex engineering problems around data scale, analytics architecture, identity, reporting, and platform convergence.
 



  





  





**ABOUT THE ROLE** 




 We are looking for a
 **Lead Engineer \- Backend / Data Platform** 
 to provide technical leadership for backend and data\-intensive systems powering analytics, reporting, experimentation, and behavioural insights across Wingify \+ AB Tasty.
 



 This is a
 **hands\-on technical leadership** 
 role, not an engineering management position.
 



 You will continue to design systems and write production code, while also owning architecture and technical direction for significant workstreams.
 



 You will work across
 **Java, ClickHouse, BigQuery, Bigtable, Redis, Kafka, and GCP,** 
 solving problems spanning event ingestion, distributed processing, query engines, analytical storage, low\-latency serving, and reporting.
 



 A key part of the role is helping us evolve two mature analytics platforms toward a more unified data foundation without compromising the reliability of systems already serving production customers.
 



  





  





**WHAT YOU'LL WORK WITH** 



* Java, Spring Boot and JVM\-based backend services
* ClickHouse and ClickHouse Cloud for high\-volume analytics
* BigQuery for large\-scale analytical workloads
* Bigtable for low\-latency NoSQL serving
* Kafka and Pub/Sub for real\-time event streaming
* Redis for caching and distributed coordination
* GCP, including GCS, Dataflow, GKE and VMs
* Apache Beam / Dataflow for distributed data processing
* Go for adjacent reporting and SQL services



  





**WHAT YOU'LL DO** 



* Own the architecture and technical design of significant backend and data\-platform workstreams.
* Design distributed systems for high\-volume event ingestion, analytical querying, data processing, and low\-latency serving.
* Remain hands\-on with Java and production backend development.
* Build and evolve backend services, APIs, query engines, data pipelines, and distributed processing systems.
* Make architectural decisions around data modelling, storage engines, partitioning, query patterns, caching, streaming, reliability, and cost.
* Design and optimise systems using ClickHouse, BigQuery, Bigtable, Redis, Kafka, and related technologies.
* Write and optimise complex analytical SQL and troubleshoot query\-performance bottlenecks.
* Solve challenging production problems involving data correctness, pipeline failures, latency, throughput, and infrastructure.
* Own critical systems from design and implementation through deployment, observability, and production operations.
* Review technical designs and architecture proposed by other engineers.
* Mentor engineers and help improve system\-design and production\-engineering capabilities across the team.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Data, and Infrastructure teams to translate complex requirements into scalable technical solutions.



  





  





**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR** 



* 6\+ years of hands\-on backend/software engineering experience.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Java and backend development.
* Experience designing and building distributed or data\-intensive production systems.
* Strong system\-design and architecture fundamentals.
* Experience with analytical databases, data warehouses, or large\-scale non\-relational databases.
* Strong understanding of data modelling, partitioning, indexing, clustering, caching, and query optimisation.
* Strong SQL skills, particularly for analytical workloads.
* Experience designing and operating event\-driven or streaming architectures using Kafka, Pub/Sub, or similar technologies.
* Experience building batch and/or streaming data pipelines at scale.
* Hands\-on cloud experience. GCP is preferred.
* Strong production debugging and troubleshooting skills across applications, databases, pipelines, and infrastructure.
* Experience reviewing technical designs, mentoring engineers, and influencing architecture.



  





  





**NICE TO HAVE** 



* Production experience with ClickHouse.
* Experience with BigQuery and/or Bigtable at scale.
* Apache Beam / Dataflow.
* Snowflake or warehouse\-native compute.
* Experience processing billions of events or TB/PB\-scale analytical datasets.
* Go or Vert.x.
* Experience with experimentation platforms, A/B testing, funnels, segmentation, identity, cohorts, or behavioural analytics.
* Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Prometheus, Grafana, or GCP Cloud Monitoring.



  





**WHY THIS ROLE** 




 You will work on a production data platform that already operates at significant scale while helping shape the next generation of analytics infrastructure across Wingify \+ AB Tasty.
 



 This is an opportunity to remain deeply hands\-on while influencing architecture, solving complex distributed\-system problems, and helping bring two mature analytics platforms onto a common data foundation.

title: Software Delivery Specialist - Healthcare Access, Quality, and Outcomes
description:
**Who You'll Work With**
 Driving lasting impact and building long\-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture \- doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.
   

  

 In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.
   

  

 When you join us, you will have:
   

  

* Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast\-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
* A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
* Global community: With colleagues across 65\+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
* World\-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well\-being for you and your family.


**Your Impact**
 You will contribute to building analytical products that help clients improve healthcare outcomes, leveraging modern data engineering tools and practices.
   

  

 Working as part of a team on active client engagements, you will support initiatives focused on delivering more affordable, accessible, and high\-quality healthcare globally.
   

  

 You will join our Client Capabilities Network in Gurugram or Bengaluru as part of the HALO (Healthcare Access, Quality, and Outcomes) domain within the SHaPE (Social, Healthcare and Public Entities) practice.
   

  

 You will design and develop interactive dashboards and visualizations using tools such as Power BI, enabling clear and effective communication of insights to clients and internal stakeholders. You will also leverage emerging Generative AI tools and agent\-based workflows to support delivery tasks such as code generation, data transformation, and documentation, improving productivity and solution quality.
   

  

 In collaboration with data engineers, product teams, and other stakeholders, you will support the development and maintenance of data pipelines, software applications, and scalable data frameworks, including reusable assets that enable efficient data processing and analysis across projects. Your work also involves configuring and delivering data and software solutions aligned with client needs, while supporting client interactions where required.
   

  

 You will translate client requirements into data models, configurations, and implementation steps under supervision, ensuring alignment with product capabilities. Applying structured problem\-solving, you will help troubleshoot data and implementation challenges, while ensuring data quality and consistency in visualizations through validation of data sources and adherence to best practices in dashboard design. You will also contribute to documentation, knowledge sharing, and capability building across data engineering, visualization, and software tools.
   

  

 SHaPE fosters innovation driven by advanced analytics, user experience design thinking, predictive forecasting to develop new products/services and integrating them into our client work. It is helping to shift our model towards asset\-based consulting and is a foundation for our entrepreneurial culture.
   

  

**Your Qualifications and Skills**
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree preferred

- 5\+ years of experience building data\-intensive applications using Python or similar languages, with strong proficiency in SQL (data modeling, query optimization, and performance tuning)

- 2\+ years of experience developing dashboards and working with data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms

- Experience with modern data platforms (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake) for data processing, storage, and analytics, along with exposure to distributed data processing frameworks (e.g., Spark, Hive, Hadoop ecosystem)

- Exposure to Generative AI (e.g., LLMs, prompt engineering, AI\-assisted development tools) and/or familiarity with NLP techniques and building data solutions leveraging unstructured data is a plus

- Solid understanding of software development best practices, including version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, DevOps tools (e.g., Jenkins), and Agile methodologies

- Interest in the healthcare domain preferred; prior experience not required

 Willingness to travel as needed (expected travel
 - Strong communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in cross\-functional and client\-facing environments

title: Salesforce Engineer
description:
**Company Overview**
 ClearView Healthcare Partners is a premier life sciences strategy consulting firm headquartered in Boston, with offices in San Francisco, New York City, London, Zurich and Gurgaon. Serving clients in the biopharmaceutical, medical device, and diagnostic spaces, we provide world\-class strategic decision\-making support across a diverse range of business issues. Our goal is to inform actionable recommendations that allow companies to achieve their business objectives.
   

  

 ClearView is looking for a Salesforce Engineer to join our Information Technology team. This role covers Platform Configuration/Development, System Administration/Integration/Support, and User Enablement and Adoption. The primary focus will be hands\-on platform development and administration/integration, with user enablement and adoption as a supporting responsibility. This position requires the ability to work with minimal direction, adapt to changing demands, and identify opportunities for process improvement. This position will work in our India office but will be responsible for ClearView’s Salesforce platform globally.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Platform Configuration and Development**
* ClearView has locations in Massachusetts, New York, California, United Kingdom, Switzerland and India. This position will be responsible for configuring and maintaining ClearView’s Salesforce org to support business processes across all locations, including declarative configuration of objects, fields, page layouts, flows, validation rules, permission sets and reports.
* Build new functionality where it does not exist today to support business development, project delivery, expert network, and finance workflows.
* Develop and maintain custom solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components, and the Salesforce APIs where declarative tools are insufficient.
* Apply Salesforce development best practices, including bulkification, governor\-limit\-aware design, automated testing, error handling and logging, asynchronous processing, code reviews, and source control.
* Maintain release management and change control practices across sandbox and production environments, including testing, deployment and documentation of changes.
* Partner with business stakeholders to gather requirements, implement Salesforce changes within established standards, and document them for ongoing support.
* Annual review of org configuration, technical debt, and license utilization, with recommendations for enhancement.


**User Enablement and Adoption**
* Partner with business stakeholders and ClearView’s training group to support Salesforce adoption and effective use of the platform.
* Support adoption through clear communication, demonstrations, documentation, and targeted enablement as new capabilities are introduced.
* Develop reference materials, release notes, and office hours to support onboarding, ongoing platform use, and new feature rollouts.
* Work with the Salesforce Architect to share Salesforce knowledge and provide targeted enablement for the Information Technology Team.


**System Administration/Integration/Support**
* Work closely with other IT Infrastructure and Applications personnel to ensure Salesforce and connected systems are securely designed, deployed, and managed. This includes SSO/SAML, organization\-wide defaults (OWD), role hierarchy and sharing rules, permission sets, CRUD/FLS enforcement, Apex security considerations, data access models, and integrations with systems currently in place at ClearView.
* Provide recommendations on changes/enhancements to the above systems to ensure ClearView is using best in class platform capabilities.
* Evaluate and refine existing integrations, data quality, and platform performance/availability.
* Manage Salesforce data lifecycle considerations, including data retention, archiving/purge, data quality, bulk data operations, and how client data is stored or retained in downstream systems and integrations.
* Serve as Salesforce subject matter expert and key technical resource for the platform and connected tools, including data management, reporting/analytics, user provisioning, and AppExchange applications.
* Identify defects and performance issues through testing, monitoring and user feedback, and work with responsible teams to address and resolve them.
* Ensure compliance with ClearView’s IT and data protection policies and follow established change management procedures.
* In the event of system outages or data issues, work directly with the Salesforce Architect to diagnose the issue, manage the remediation process, and document the results.


**Other Responsibilities**
* Provide technical Salesforce expertise, support platform initiatives, and contribute to the Salesforce roadmap.
* Design and implement standardized deployment and testing checklists for all new Salesforce releases and connected applications.
* Stay current with Salesforce seasonal releases and new platform capabilities and recommend appropriate action.
* Work with the Head of Information Technology to support audit processes related to system access and data integrity.
* As per client MSAs, ensure client data held in Salesforce is protected and ultimately purged as required.
* Perform other related duties and activities as required.


**Job Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s Degree in a technical or computer science related discipline. Advanced degree preferred.
* 4\-7 years of relevant Salesforce configuration and development experience.
* Salesforce Platform Developer II certification or equivalent demonstrated real\-world Salesforce development experience.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to business and non\-technical stakeholders and support adoption through documentation, demonstrations, and training.
* Demonstrates strong problem solving, analytical, interpersonal, and ownership skills.
* Possesses excellent collaboration skills for work with various internal team members.


**Required Skills/Experience**
* Strong hands\-on experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL, Flow, Salesforce REST/SOAP APIs, sandbox management, and data loading tools.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce data modeling, automation design, governor limits, platform scalability, and security, including OWD, sharing rules, permission sets, CRUD/FLS, SSO/SAML, and Apex security considerations.
* Experience applying Salesforce development best practices, including bulkification, automated testing, error handling/logging, asynchronous processing, code reviews, source control, and maintainable implementations.
* Experience building and supporting Salesforce integrations using established patterns and APIs, including downstream data lifecycle and retention considerations.
* Experience with Salesforce DevOps, release management, testing, source control, and deployments across sandbox and production environments.
* Experience with Salesforce data management, including data quality, bulk data operations, retention and archiving/purge, plus Salesforce Sales Cloud and advanced reporting/dashboard development.


**Preferred Skills/Experience**
* Experience with Salesforce Experience Cloud, CPQ, or Marketing Cloud.
* Experience with middleware or integration tools such as MuleSoft, Zapier, or Power Automate.


**What We Value**
 We recognize that not every candidate will meet every qualification listed. If you’re excited about this role and believe you have relevant experience or transferable skills, we encourage you to apply. We value curiosity, a growth mindset, and a commitment to collaboration.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 ClearView Healthcare Partners ("CV") is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
